answer: Latency-Budget Attestation Windows** Each identity must answer a signed challenge within a randomized window while maintaining a low-variance response-time signal across rounds; agents that reply too uniformly are flagged. The coordinator builds a trellis of per-identity arrival histograms and rejects patterns denser than a set branching factor per epoch. An attacker must provision a full vine of distinct network paths with genuine timing jitter, paying real bandwidth and coordination cost per fake identity rather than a one-time fee.
